user.title: Add a ComEd price sensor
user.description: Each sensor shows one ComEd price. For more, such as both prices, or one in cents and one in dollars, add the integration again.

data_description.type: The 5-minute price changes every 5 minutes. The current hour average is the average of this hour's 5-minute prices so far.
data_description.price_unit: Choose dollars for the Energy dashboard. It reads ¢/kWh as dollars, so cents would make every cost 100 times too high.
data_description.offset: Added to every price, in ¢/kWh even when the unit is dollars. ComEd's prices are for supply only, so this is where delivery charges and other per-kWh fees go.
data_description.name: Leave blank to use the price's name, with "USD" added for dollars.

error.name_in_use: There's already a sensor called {entity_id}. Choose a different name, or first delete that sensor in Settings → Devices & services → Entities.

init.title: Change the offset
init.description: To change the price or the unit, add a new sensor instead.

data_description.offset: Added to every price, in ¢/kWh even when the unit is dollars.
